content.headline: The Officer Operating System — your daily AI playbook
content.body: A one-page playbook aligned with IndiaAI's Do No Harm principle: choose tool, choose data tier, prompt with structure, verify, then act.
bullets: Step 1: Choose the right tool for the job
Step 2: Choose the environment by data sensitivity (tiers 1–4)
Step 3: Use Role · Context · Task · Audience · Tone · Length · Format · Avoid
Step 4: For long documents, use NotebookLM / RAG — public files only
Step 5: Verify facts; label SGI / synthetic media where required
Step 6: Save best prompts and personas; never upload the never-upload list
